snippet.title: Agatha Christie – The ABC Murders – Launch Trailer – PlayStation 5 & Xbox Series
snippet.description:
Agatha Christie - The ABC Murders is now available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S!

Immerse yourself in the world of one of the world's most famous detectives, Hercule Poirot, and take up the challenge set by a mysterious killer. Check out the launch trailer and get ready to get your little grey cells firing!

Order your game:
On Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/fr-fr/games/store/agatha-christie-the-abc-murders-xbox-series/9N7TKVBG2PZG
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/fr-fr/concept/200115

Available now in physical and digital editions.

🕵️‍♂️ About the game:
The ABC Murders is a 3rd-person investigative adventure game, adapted from Agatha Christie's famous novel. As Hercule Poirot, you must hunt down a formidable adversary known as "ABC".

🌍 Investigation and exploration:
Travel across the UK, examine lavish crime scenes, interrogate suspects and solve complex puzzles to uncover the truth.

🔍 Game features:
- Interrogations: Gather crucial information by examining suspects and analyzing their testimonies.
- Riddles: Solve puzzles to find additional clues.
- Deductions: Use the clues collected to make deductions and unravel the murderer's mystery.
- Timeline: Follow the chronology of events to guide your investigation and progress through the story.

🎮 Optimized performance:
4K 30FPS for stunning graphics.
1080p 60FPS for maximum game fluidity.

#abc #herculepoirot #murdermystery #aventure #gaming
